card.line: Joktheel was a city in Judah's land, and also the new name King Amaziah gave to Sela after he beat the Edomites there.

moments.title: A city in Judah
moments.text: Joktheel is listed among the cities given to the tribe of Judah. It is named with towns like Mizpeh and Lachish.

moments.title: Sela renamed Joktheel
moments.text: King Amaziah of Judah struck down 10,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt. He took Sela in battle and called it Joktheel, a name it still had when this was written.
